scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:rwrc
scripts.build:schema: rm -rf .typia-temp && ttsc -p tsconfig.typia.json && node .typia-temp/tools/generate-cir-schema.js && npx prettier --write .vscode/settings.json
scripts.build:rwrc: rm -rf .typia-temp && ttsc -p tsconfig.typia.json && bun build .typia-temp/rwrc/index.js --compile --outfile dist/rwrc
scripts.build:runtime: mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/include && bun run cp -R src/runtime/include dist/include && clang -I dist/include src/runtime/*.c -dynamiclib -fvisibility=hidden -current_version 0.0.1 -compatibility_version 0.0.1 -o dist/libClawr.A.dylib
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
